title: Dev Preview Testbed
text:
1 Preface
A throwaway book (EDITED-MARKER-42) used to exercise publish-dev.sh and cleanup-dev.sh against a real GitHub Pages staging site. It mirrors the parts of the real book that the preview workflow touches: a book project with chapters in a subdirectory, freeze: auto with committed _freeze/, a themed HTML format, a production site-url, Google Analytics, and a CNAME listed under resources.
